description:
List intents from team members for this repository.

Use this to:
- See what your team is working on
- Check for potential overlapping work before starting a new task
- Review the status of various features/refactors in progress

Filtering (status, author, date range) and pagination are applied server-side across the full result set (default: 50 per page; use limit/offset to page). `count` is the total number of matching intents, not just the returned page.

author.description: Filter by author name or ID

limit.description: Maximum number of intents to return (default: 50)

offset.description: Number of intents to skip for pagination (default: 0)

repoOrigin.description: Git remote origin URL. Auto-detected from repoPath via git if not provided.

repoPath.description: Local path to the repository root

since.description: Filter intents updated after this ISO8601 date (e.g. "2026-04-01")

until.description: Filter intents updated before this ISO8601 date

name: list_team_intents
